hero-footer.looks: A centred closing statement on a light background with a large faint heart: a two-line heading (the second line larger), a paragraph and two buttons. A second style makes the first line red.
hero-footer.use: The last block of most pages: the mission line plus 'Subscribe to Updates' and 'Support NCMEC'.
hero-footer.avoid: A mid-page call to action: use a CTA block.

fields.heading_line1: The smaller first line, e.g. 'Every child deserves'.
fields.heading_line2: The larger second line, e.g. 'a safe childhood.'
fields.heading_subtext: One or two sentences under the heading.
fields.button1Text: First button, e.g. 'Subscribe to Updates', with button1.
fields.button2Text: Second button, e.g. 'Support NCMEC', with button2.
fields.image: Optional background image; leave empty for the standard light background.
fields.variant: default; variant-2 makes the first line red and medium-sized and the second line a section-heading size.
